title: WorldPainter: one grid control instead of the Grid dialog button plus the grid adjust toggle

sections.what: The toolbar carries two adjacent grid buttons: '▦ Grid…' opens a dialog for exact numbers and '✥ grid' toggles on-canvas drag handles. Merge them into one 'Grid' control that offers both.
sections.why: Reported by the author as odd, and confirmed in _toolbar (editor.ts lines 1539 and 1542): two buttons appended back to back, one calling _openGridDialog and one toggling state.gridEdit. task-717 and task-597 built both on purpose (exact numbers vs direct manipulation), so this is a presentation merge, not a removal of either mode. A toolbar with 14+ controls pays for every redundant one.
sections.how: Replace the two buttons with a single 'Grid' button that opens a small popover holding the current size, an 'Exact size...' action that opens the existing dialog, and an 'Adjust on canvas' toggle bound to state.gridEdit. Keep the data-role wp-grid-adjust hook so existing tests and help coach cards still find the toggle. Reuse _openGridDialog unchanged.

acceptance.text: The toolbar shows one grid control where it showed two.
Both exact-number resize and on-canvas handle adjust remain reachable from it.
Grid adjust mode still shows the green cell-size handle and the E/S/SE frame handles.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: WorldPainter, top toolbar next to the value picker

Current availability: Both buttons exist today; the merged control is not built.

Live steps when available:
1. Open WorldPainter on a scope with a grid and count the grid buttons in the top toolbar. expected after fix: one.
2. Open it, use Exact size to resize, then toggle Adjust on canvas and drag the E handle. expected: both work.

This section defines intended access and live acceptance. It is not a claim that planned UI exists or works today. Current availability says what is implemented and verified now; the numbered steps say how to reach and test the intended surface once it is available.
